targetText: This pamphlet was written with an eye to the tsarist censorship.
summary: Lenin had to write this text cautiously using indirect economic terms to pass Russian imperial censorship.
context: Because of tsarist political repression, Lenin used Aesopian language to discuss imperialist war without getting banned.

targetText: forced to confine myself strictly to an exclusively theoretical, specifically economic analysis of facts
summary: forced to confine myself strictly to an exclusively theoretical, specifically... this statement highlights key economic principles governing class relations under capitalism.
context: Essential theoretical analysis of capital, wages, and social relations.

targetText: unless this is studied, it will be impossible to understand and appraise modern war and modern politics.
summary: One cannot understand modern warfare or global politics without analyzing the economic roots of imperialism.
context: Lenin argues that World War I was driven by economic competition between monopoly powers, not moral disputes.
